description: This file contains test cases for Sass mixins related to color modes, including generating data attribute selectors and media query styles for dark mode. It uses @include for test setup, assertions, and output checks.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for a specific feature or behavior.

methods.name: assert
methods.description: Sets up assertions within a test case.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Checks the output CSS generated by Sass mixins.

methods.description: Defines the expected CSS output for verification.

methods.name: color-mode
methods.description: Sass mixin that generates styles for specified color modes, such as 'dark' mode, either using data attributes or media queries.
